title: Wide-angle / two enclosing barrels, three simple spacers, no internal optical cells

parts.name: 01_FrontBarrel
parts.role: Front barrel: front-load G3, thick spacer, G2 and directly abutting G1; front retainer. Rear OD34 male pilot overlaps rear barrel by 10 mm.

parts.name: 02_RearBarrel
parts.role: Rear main barrel with integral stop: G5/spacer/G4 from front; G6/spacer/G7 from rear. Flat aperture land 1 mm long, downstream 45 degree bevel, optical S13 at upstream land face.

parts.name: 03_G2G3_Spacer
parts.role: Rectangular spacer: 2.365 mm axial, 4.5 mm radial; contacts G2 rear peripheral flat and new G3 front flat.

parts.name: 04_G4G5_Spacer
parts.role: Robust rectangular spacer, 3 mm radial width; seats on calculated spherical contact circles, without a thin stepped lip.

parts.name: 05_G6G7_Spacer
parts.role: Rectangular spacer, 2.4 mm radial width; G6 rear flat to G7 front contact circle.

parts.name: 06_FrontRetainer
parts.role: Front lock ring, 3 mm axial; clamps G1-G2-direct-contact-spacer-G3 onto rear seat.

parts.name: 07_MiddleRetainer
parts.role: Front-access lock ring of rear barrel; clamps G4-spacer-G5 onto integral stop carrier seat.

parts.name: 08_RearRetainer
parts.role: Rear lock ring; clamps G7-spacer-G6 onto integral barrel seat.

radial_features.kind: Three M3 tap drill holes in 10 mm pilot
Three M3 clearance holes in common enclosing socket

assembly_scheme: Two enclosing barrels joined in a 10 mm metal pilot/socket overlap. Front stack loads from object side. Rear barrel has independent front/rear stacks about an integral thick stop platform. No adhesive or internal cells required in this demo.

front: Load G3 from front onto rear shoulder
Install G2 with added OD30 peripheral flange
Install G1: direct annular contact with G2 at r14..15
rear_front: Before connecting barrels: load G5 from front onto integral rear seat
rear_back: Load G6 from rear onto front shoulder
final: Complete both barrel subassemblies first: front pilot bore will cover middle retainer access after mating
Slide rear barrel socket over front barrel male pilot from rear to Z38 shoulder
Fasten three M3 radial joint screws; no optical cell flanges exposed

warnings: Nominal editable demo: original optical files unchanged; added mechanical rims require newly manufactured optics.
No aperture/ray clipping check requested. No actual thread teeth, screw solids, preload, tolerance or stress/thermal verification.
Retaining-ring interfaces are nominal smooth thread envelopes. Polyline lens reference entities are not production optical surfaces.
